# ShopPulse

> GST-compliant billing, inventory, and CRM for Indian IT/CCTV service businesses.
> Vanilla HTML + CSS + JS SPA. No backend. No npm. Data in browser localStorage.

## What this app does

- Creates GST Tax Invoices (CGST+SGST intra-state, IGST inter-state) with print support
- Tracks sales invoices and purchase bills (paid / unpaid / overdue)
- Manages receivables aging and payables aging
- Manages product inventory with HSN codes and reorder alerts
- Stores customers and suppliers with GSTIN validation
- Generates GSTR-1 (B2B, B2C, HSN summary) and GSTR-3B reports
- Exports to CSV for CA/GST filing
- AI assistant for business insights (rule-based, no external API)

## Tech stack

- HTML5 + Vanilla CSS + Vanilla JavaScript (ES6, strict mode)
- Chart.js 4.4.3 (CDN) for dashboard revenue chart
- Google Material Icons + Inter font (CDN)
- localStorage for all data persistence
- Hash-based SPA routing (#dashboard, #billing-sales, etc.)

## File map

```
index.html          — app shell, loads all scripts in order
css/index.css       — design tokens, layout, sidebar, print styles
css/components.css  — buttons, forms, tables, modals, toasts, KPI cards
css/modules.css     — page-specific styles (billing form, CCTV, AI chat)
js/data.js          — DB object, GST engine (calcTotals), seed data, global utils
js/app.js           — router, dashboard, modal API, toast API, settings page
js/billing.js       — invoice CRUD, print (GST-compliant), receivables, payables
js/inventory.js     — product CRUD, stock adjustment
js/crm.js           — customer/supplier CRUD, transaction history
js/expenses.js      — expense tracking, categories, GST ITC calculation, CSV export
js/reports.js       — GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, P&L, CSV export
js/ai.js            — AI assistant (business health, forecast, reorder, GST check)
README.md           — full human-readable documentation
AGENTS.md           — AI agent coding instructions (architecture, rules, patterns)
```

## Core data API (js/data.js)

```js
DB.getSales() / getSaleById(id) / saveSale(obj, isNew) / deleteSale(id)
DB.getPurchases() / getPurchaseById(id) / savePurchase(obj, isNew) / deletePurchase(id)
DB.getExpenses() / getExpenseById(id) / saveExpense(obj) / deleteExpense(id)
DB.getProducts() / getProductById(id) / saveProduct(obj) / deleteProduct(id)
DB.getCustomers() / getCustomerById(id) / saveCustomer(obj) / deleteCustomer(id)
DB.getSuppliers() / getSupplierById(id) / saveSupplier(obj) / deleteSupplier(id)
DB.getBiz() / setBiz(obj)
DB.adjustStock(productId, delta)
DB.nextInvoiceNo()  // "SCS/2024-25/0001"
DB.nextBillNo()     // "SCS-PO/2024-25/0001"
```

## GST engine

```js
calcTotals(items, sellerStateCode, buyerStateCode)
// Same state → CGST + SGST (intra-state)
// Diff state → IGST (inter-state)
// Returns: { items[], subtotal, totalCgst, totalSgst, totalIgst, totalTax, total, isIntra }
```

## Global utilities

```js
fmtCurrency(n)          // ₹1,23,456.00 (Indian format)
fmtDate("2024-08-15")   // "15 Aug 2024"
validateGSTIN(str)      // true/false (15-char format check)
numberToWords(n)        // "Fifty Thousand Two Hundred..."
genId("INV")            // "INV-a1b2c3"
getFY()                 // "2024-25"
daysBetween(d1, d2)     // integer days

// Constants
INDIAN_STATES           // [{name, code}] all 37 states/UTs
GST_RATES               // [0, 0.1, 0.25, 1, 1.5, 3, 5, 7.5, 12, 18, 28]
UNITS                   // ["Nos", "Pcs", "Box", "Job", "Visit", ...]
PAYMENT_METHODS         // ["Bank Transfer", "NEFT", "RTGS", "UPI", "Cheque", "Cash"]
```

## localStorage keys

```
sp_biz / sp_sales / sp_purchases / sp_products / sp_customers / sp_suppliers
sp_categories / sp_movements / sp_seeded
```
Reset: `localStorage.clear(); location.reload()`

## Business profile (demo seed data)

- Business: SysCare Computer Services, Pune, Maharashtra (stateCode: 27)
- GSTIN: 27AABCT5432R1ZP
- Invoice prefix: SCS → format SCS/2024-25/0001
- 6 customers: IT company, school, hospital, municipal corp, manufacturer (Gujarat), hotel
- 4 suppliers: Ingram Micro, Rashi Peripherals, Hikvision, Redington
- 19 products: laptops (HSN 8471), CCTV cams (8525), NVR (8521), switches (8517),
  UPS (8504), RAM/SSD (8473), cables (8544), AMC service (SAC 998314),
  CCTV install (998714), network setup (998313), repair (998731)
- 8 sales invoices + 5 purchase bills (mix of paid/unpaid/overdue)

## How to run

Open `index.html` directly in browser, or:
```
python -m http.server 3000
```

## Strict rules for AI agents

- No npm, no build tools, no ES modules (import/export)
- Script load order: data.js → app.js → billing.js → inventory.js → crm.js → reports.js → ai.js
- All modules are plain const objects on window scope
- Never call localStorage directly — always use DB.*
- Never duplicate GST logic — always call calcTotals()
- See AGENTS.md for full coding rules and patterns
